status: Accepted six bounded copy edits after exact source-hash and field checks
scope: Front matter/rules and a spot read of P001, P081 and P201; only P001 and P081 receive case edits. This is not an audit of all 240 games.

changes.before: find something you want another turn with.
changes.after: find a game you want to return to.
changes.reason: The original 'turn with' construction is awkward. The shorter invitation also fits games that do not use turns.

changes.before: Article 2. Record three things the evening does not need
changes.after: Article 2. Name what the evening needs
changes.reason: Match the body, which permits fewer than three preferences and includes positive wishes such as native co-op.

changes.before: One purchase per selection is the limit.
changes.after: Spend at most one token per selection.
changes.reason: Identify the fictional token explicitly; 'purchase' could otherwise be read as referring to a game purchase.

changes.before: A local case number never becomes zero.
changes.after: The final local case number is always between 1 and 40.
changes.reason: The next worked example intentionally reaches zero before wrapping. Distinguish that intermediate result from the final valid case number without changing the arithmetic.

changes.before: Have a helper set manual advance if wanted.
changes.after: Set manual speech advance if you want it, with help if useful.
changes.reason: Address the reader directly and make assistance optional. The documented speech setting and the rest of the trial remain intact.

changes.before: Open one box in the first room and place three objects.
changes.after: Open one box in the first room and place an object.
changes.reason: One placement is enough to introduce the action. Remove an arbitrary three-object target while retaining the visibility and click-control checks.
